results.name: Production API does not expose QA state mutation
Idle combat cannot move, attack or change HP before start
RAF can draw 120 frames without starting combat
Only player and T. rex are active fighters; no character mutation API
Movement remains inside both arena boundaries and collision gap
Pause freezes time, movement and health; resume restores updates
Distant player attack causes T. rex dodge with no damage
T. rex parries attacks during windup with no HP damage
Tired T. rex parry during recovery lets through damage
Undefended Rex strike automatically provokes player dodge
Fresh guard reflects Rex strike and damages only Rex
Active manual dodge avoids an incoming strike at low remaining stamina
Eight successive perfect parries can legitimately defeat Rex
Exhausted late parry can reduce player to zero and lose
After HP defeat, combat state stops responding and no further damage occurs
Five minutes passing cannot produce victory without defeating Rex
